items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Jack Johnson used to come in the nightclub all the time. He used to like to play the drums. He get up there and act a fool like he's playin' the drums.

ctx.x: We had a floorshow...a big floorshow...had Count Basie's band. And I never forget...Jack Johnson used to come in the nightclub all the time. He used to like to play the drums. He get up there and act a fool like he's playin' the drums. I'm talkin' about the prizefighter Jack Johnson.
